mapper.select: select * from pcd_directory_tree_table where node_parent_id is null and ((#{currentSpaceId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} is null and node_user_id=#{user_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}) or node_space_id=#{currentSpaceId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} or (#{personalSpace}=true and node_space_id is null and node_user_id=#{user_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler})) order by node_create_time asc limit 1;

SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pcd_directory_closure_table c JOIN pcd_directory_tree_table n ON n.node_user_id = c.user_id AND n.node_id = c.ancestor_id WHERE c.descendant_id = #{node_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} AND ((#{currentSpaceId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} IS NULL AND c.user_id = #{user_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}) OR c.closure_space_id=#{currentSpaceId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} OR (#{personalSpace}=true AND c.closure_space_id IS NULL AND c.user_id=#{user_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler})) AND n.node_status IN ('TRASHED', 'DELETED') LIMIT 1 )

SELECT CASE MIN( CASE n.node_status WHEN 'DELETED' THEN 1 WHEN 'TRASHED' THEN 2 END ) WHEN 1 THEN 'DELETED' WHEN 2 THEN 'TRASHED' ELSE 'ACTIVE' END AS effective_status FROM pcd_directory_closure_table c JOIN pcd_directory_tree_table n ON n.node_user_id = c.user_id AND n.node_id = c.ancestor_id WHERE c.descendant_id = #{node_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} AND ((#{currentSpaceId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} IS NULL AND c.user_id = #{user_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}) OR c.closure_space_id=#{currentSpaceId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} OR (#{personalSpace}=true AND c.closure_space_id IS NULL AND c.user_id=#{user_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler})) AND n.node_status IN ('TRASHED', 'DELETED')
mapper.insert: insert into pcd_directory_tree_table (node_id, node_user_id, node_parent_id, node_name, node_create_time, node_status, node_space_id) values(#{node_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}, #{user_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}, #{parent_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}, #{name}, #{create_time}, #{status}, #{space_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler});
